region.why: a deployment fact: HCAZERRS ASSIGNs SYSID into the message it writes; the corpus names no region

notes: The example-health-apis add-medication screen program HCMAPL01 (map HCMAMAP): first entry sends the screen; ENTER with a drug name LINKs HCMABA01 (the real front end and its Db2 programs run), ENTER with none LINKs HCP1BI01 for the patient name; PF3, PF12, CLEAR and MAPFAIL take their HANDLE AID / HANDLE CONDITION arms. Tables come from the estate's @DB2CRE.jcl (HCZMSA1). The seed holds one patient (id 1) so HCP1BI01 finds it and GET-PATIENT reads return code 0; the EVALUATE WHEN 70 arm stays open (no callee in the chain moves 70, but branch_solver reports a witness, so no infeasible entry). Derived from IBM's example-health-apis (github.com/ibm/example-health-apis, Apache-2.0; (C) Copyright IBM Corp. 2011, 2014): LICENSE here is the corpus's own, NOTICE names the source and what was derived. The terminal is stated as T001 (a deployment fact; RETURN TRANSID IMMEDIATE needs one, register X27).

scenarios.name: first-entry
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: INITIALIZE the map and COMM-AREA, send HCMAMAP with ERASE and CURSOR, then RETURN TRANSID HCMA

scenarios.name: add-medication
scenarios.why: a drug name was typed: LINK HCMABA01 with the 01AMED request (MEDICATION and PRESCRIPTION rows); return code 0 so 'New medication added'

scenarios.name: add-unknown-patient
scenarios.why: HCMABA01 returns 90 (foreign key): NO-ADD takes WHEN OTHER, 'Error Adding Medication', SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK first

scenarios.name: get-patient-found
scenarios.why: no drug name: GET-PATIENT LINKs HCP1BI01 (01IPAT) and fills the first and last name

scenarios.name: pf3
scenarios.why: HANDLE AID PF3: ENDIT sends 'Transaction ended'

scenarios.name: pf12
scenarios.why: HANDLE AID PF12: CANCELIT RETURNs TRANSID HCAZ IMMEDIATE

scenarios.name: clear
scenarios.why: HANDLE AID CLEAR: the map is resent MAPONLY

scenarios.name: enter-no-map-received
scenarios.why: RECEIVE MAP raises MAPFAIL: HANDLE CONDITION sends ENDIT
